tasks.short: Advise engineering students on curricula and careers.

steps.what: Understand the student's engineering interests, academic position and career concerns
Check programme prerequisites and laboratory eligibility in the student information system
Advise the student on curriculum choices and engineering career trade-offs
Write and check the private advising record and student-facing action note
Commit the approved advising record in the student information system
Send the approved action note to the advised student

tasks.design: Use the native programme audit in {OTHER}, the student information system, to expose prerequisites and recorded laboratory eligibility. Keep curricular interpretation, career discussion and note writing human. Separately gate record commit and {EMAIL} action-note delivery on completed audience-specific versions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course eligibility does not decide which engineering pathway suits a student.
tasks.enabler_now: Native programme views can consolidate rule and completion records.
tasks.still_hard: Exceptions, career uncertainty and personal goals need conversation.
tasks.human_edge: Help the student make a considered choice rather than predict a career outcome.
tasks.altitude: Less curricular navigation and approved note transfer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native programme audits can compare explicit prerequisites with recorded completions; local rule coverage needs confirmation.

assumptions: Provisional shares concern teacher work only. Verify actual navigation and transfer actions; existing native automation earns no saving.

Programme administration supplies rule_version, course_id, prerequisite, laboratory_training_requirement and availability; student administration supplies completion and training_status. s1/s2 retain identity, history capture, interpretation and manual exceptions. Missing records require manual checking, not inferred eligibility.

s4 teacher captures action, source_rule, owner and due_date and approves actual separate private/student versions. a1 binds private destination; a2 binds final student note and recipient. Edits revoke approval. No enrolment or laboratory access changes are made.
research_questions: Can the native view distinguish recorded eligibility from exceptional approval still needed?

incremental.description: Check programme-rule versions and note destinations

approvals.approved_version: s4 final private advising record and destination
s4 final student action note and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 navigation and 5 save/send hours minus 0.5 upkeep = 10.5. Low halves navigation only and keeps transfer manual: 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic or administrative committees.

steps.what: Compare the current and proposed institutional policy versions
Assess academic, departmental and engineering implications of the proposed policy
Serve on the committee and deliberate on academic or administrative issues
Write and check the teacher's final written committee contribution
Send the approved contribution to the internal committee secretary

tasks.design: Enable native version comparison in {DOCS} so the member sees literal policy edits with their surrounding text. Retain interpretation, deliberation and written contribution. A separate {EMAIL} send follows approval of the completed contribution. Committee-wide minutes and policy publication remain with their actual owners and earn no teacher saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Members must distinguish wording changes from their institutional consequences.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document comparison can locate literal edits without summarising policy meaning.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing trade-offs and reaching a legitimate committee decision remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Bring engineering teaching evidence to a policy debate and understand colleagues' concerns.
tasks.altitude: Less manual change-location work, unchanged policy judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document comparison can locate changes between policy versions without deciding their significance.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a policy-review committee item with an individual written contribution. Check actual manual comparison and send work; existing comparison features earn no new saving.

Committee secretary supplies document_id, prior_version, proposed_version and agenda_item. s1 retains version confirmation and reading of the changed context. Missing/misaligned documents are compared manually; no free reconstructed source is assumed.

s4 teacher writes and checks agenda_item, position, evidence and requested_action. No transcript or automatic committee minutes are generated. a1 binds the actual final contribution and secretary recipient after s4; edits revoke approval.
research_questions: Does native comparison remove manual location work while preserving the context needed to assess a policy edit?

incremental.description: Check version links and committee recipient routing

approvals.approved_version: s4 final contribution and committee secretary recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 comparison-navigation and 3 send hours minus 0.5 upkeep = 8.5. Low halves comparison benefit and retains manual send: 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform administrative duties as an engineering department head.

steps.what: Confirm teaching needs, staff capacity and laboratory-resource constraints
Compare feasible staff and laboratory allocations against explicit constraints
Negotiate assignments and decide fair allocations within delegated authority
Write and check final allocation records and staff instructions
Commit the approved department allocation record
Send approved allocation instructions to the internal staff recipients

tasks.design: For recurring teaching-resource administration, use the current {SPREADSHEET} allocation model before custom code. Show explicit staff/laboratory conflicts; keep all negotiation, final choice and fresh record writing human. {OTHER} is the laboratory booking system, read only. Separate the final {PROJECT} record commit and {EMAIL} staff instructions after the head's completed-version check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feasibility checks are mixed with fair allocation decisions and interpersonal negotiation.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit workload and resource constraints permit deterministic comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Fairness, exceptional needs and safe laboratory coverage remain accountable department decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate commitments that staff can actually deliver.
tasks.altitude: Less manual allocation checking and approved record transfer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit workload and booking constraints can be compared deterministically while final allocation remains human.

assumptions: Provisional shares concern teaching/laboratory allocation administration, not every head duty. Validate actual manual comparison and record transfer; existing formulas/runtime earn no new benefit.

Programme office supplies course_id, hours, cohort_size and required_equipment; staff administration supplies staff_id, available_hours and qualifications; laboratory office supplies resource_id, capacity and availability. s1 head confirms and captures all mismatches/constraints at full time. No free clean allocation dataset is assumed.

s2 returns conflicts for missing capacity or qualifications rather than filling them. Try native booking views/spreadsheet formulas first. It never assigns staff automatically or changes laboratory access.

s4 head captures final_owner, course, resource, dates and exceptions and checks the actual final records/instructions. a1/a2 bind those versions and destinations after s4; edits invalidate approval. Formal timetable changes outside the department record require their own authorised workflow and receive no savings here.
research_questions: Which hands-on feasibility comparisons remain after existing spreadsheet formulas and booking views?

incremental.description: Maintain allocation constraint mappings and routing

approvals.approved_version: s4 final allocation record and department destination
s4 final individual staff instructions and recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 feasibility-check and 5 record/send hours minus 1.5 upkeep = 18.5. Low halves feasibility benefit and keeps all writes manual: 7.5 minus 1.5 = 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review engineering manuscripts for professional journals.

steps.what: Read the manuscript and assess its engineering contribution, methods and claims
Check selected calculations with native engineering calculation tools
Write the journal review using its native structured report template
Check and approve the final review, recommendation and confidential-editor comments
Submit the approved review through the journal's editorial system

tasks.design: Keep the entire manuscript reading and scientific judgement human. Configure local/native calculation functions in {SPREADSHEET}/{OTHER}, the permitted engineering calculation environment, and the journal's report headings in {DOCS}. Retain substantive review writing and final checking. Submit the actual approved report manually through {OTHER}, the journal editorial system. No manuscript or review enters a drafting model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Valid peer review requires independent engineering assessment and confidentiality.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calculation functions and report templates can reduce repeated arithmetic setup and report layout.
tasks.still_hard: Originality, method validity, missing evidence and the recommendation remain expert judgements.
tasks.human_edge: Identify a consequential physical assumption and explain a fair, actionable criticism.
tasks.altitude: Small preparation gains with full scientific responsibility retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native calculation functions and review templates can support a human peer reviewer without generated scientific judgements.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; no reading-time reduction is claimed. s2/s3 savings apply only if actual repeated arithmetic setup and report layout remain manual; existing formulas/templates give no new benefit.

s1/s2 reviewer chooses checks and manually captures equation, parameter, unit, boundary_condition and expected_limit. Derivation, input entry, interpretation and finding mistakes remain within s2's retained 16 hours. No author-provided clean executable model is assumed.

s3 template provides only the journal's required headings and reviewer-supplied manuscript_id; substantive critique and recommendation retain 16 hours. No reference or numerical baseline is invented and no journal policy is inferred.

All handling follows the journal's actual confidentiality rules in permitted local tools. s4 checks the complete final author/editor sections and recommendation; a1 binds that package and manuscript destination. s5 retains portal entry and final submission time, with no hypothetical automation credit.
research_questions: Does the reviewer have repeated arithmetic setup or report formatting left after current native tools?

incremental.description: Check report headings and calculation-template assumptions

approvals.approved_version: s4 final review, recommendation, confidential sections and manuscript destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 4 calculation setup and 4 report-layout hours minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Low halves only calculation benefit and keeps report layout unchanged: 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Reading, scientific decisions and submission retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Support engineering advice, academic governance and peer review with explicit native-tool changes.
reach: Help departments describe resource constraints and journals receive clearly structured human reviews.
role.ambitious_version: An engineering academic whose administrative records are reliable and whose decisions remain grounded in students, staff and technical evidence.
